subject: Plain ASCII message
notes: Baseline: us-ascii text/plain, no encodings.

subject: Привет, мир
notes: multipart/alternative, UTF-8 quoted-printable in both parts, RFC 2047 Q-encoded subject.

subject: Тест KOI8-R
notes: Raw 8-bit koi8-r body, B-encoded koi8-r subject.

subject: Отчёт за квартал
notes: windows-1251 quoted-printable body, Q-encoded subject; '№' exists only in cp1251, not in koi8-r.

subject: Base64 тема ✓
notes: UTF-8 base64 body and B-encoded subject, non-Latin and non-BMP-adjacent characters.

subject: Nested multipart
notes: mixed > related > alternative; inline PNG referenced by cid; two real attachments. Inline image is not an attachment.

subject: Inline image only
notes: HTML-only related message; the image has a Content-ID and no filename.

subject: Unicode attachment names
notes: RFC 2231 (filename*=UTF-8'') and legacy RFC 2047 encoded-word file names.

subject: Fwd attached message
notes: Nested message/rfc822 attachment with its own headers (Subject: Inner message).

subject: Urgent: verify your account
notes: Sanitizer input: script, event handlers, javascript:/data: links, iframe/object/embed, form, SVG script, CSS expression/url, meta refresh, base, @import, conditional comment. After sanitizing, none of these may remain; 'safe-marker' and the https link must survive.

subject: Dangerous attachments
notes: SVG and HTML attachments declared 'inline' and a path-traversal file name. They must be served as attachment with nosniff, never inline; the name must be sanitized to a plain file name.

subject: Weekly newsletter
notes: Tracking pixel, remote images in img/background/srcset/table, remote stylesheet, protocol-relative URL. All must be blocked by default and rewritten to the proxy when allowed.

subject: HTML only
notes: Single text/html part; the text version must be derived (or absent) without errors.

subject: Attachment only
notes: No text or HTML body at all; the viewer must show an empty body, not fail.

subject: =?UTF-8?Q?unterminated encoded word
textContains: Body with bare LF line endings
notes: No Date or Message-ID, bare LF endings, unterminated encoded word, duplicate Subject, unknown charset. The parser must not throw; show raw subject text when decoding fails.

subject: Verified sender
notes: dkim=pass, spf=pass, dmarc=pass -> 'sender verified'.

subject: Your account is locked
textContains: Sign in now to unlock your account.
notes: spf=fail, dkim=none, dmarc=fail -> 'looks like fraud' warning.

subject: Re: Привет, мир
notes: Reply with In-Reply-To/References and a quoted block (for quote folding and reply composition tests).

subject: Длинная тема письма с кириллицей и эмодзи 🚀 которая переносится на несколько строк
notes: One UTF-8 character is split between two RFC 2047 encoded words (non-conforming but common); decoders must join bytes before decoding.

subject: Many recipients
notes: 30 folded To recipients plus Cc; for address list parsing and reply-all.
